title: A newcomer's life: a lean land and a second pack
about: As `life`, with berry bushes at 30% of the island's density and the wolves moved off the arrival road: no pack on the town road, and two bold packs (five and four) ranging 120-250 m around the first village, Elmwick (a seed `packs` entry can only be placed near the arrival point or the first settlement of a kind). In l2/l3 (378b2c1) the preset kept the shipped road pack and added a second pack by the arrival point: both finished replicates died to wolves on the arrival road (48 s and day 3), so it measured that one road.
gradient: Arrive safely in a lean land -> find food where berries are scarce (the bow, fishing, trapping, the town's gardens and stores) -> meet wolves when ranging toward the villages -> safety (fire, shelter, the walled town) -> a place that holds.
